reason: Reproduced exactly: driving notes.seam at 1440, Send to Tasks then Open in Tasks lands seam_n14_1 in todo with .cardTitle 'Switch on before guests arrive, not when' and .cardNote 'Switch on before guests arrive, not when.' — one trailing period apart — because the guard at src/app.js:707 compares unnormalised strings; the comment above it already promises the note carries nothing when the title IS the words. This is the SAME defect as seam-card-repeats-its-own-title (same element, same line, same fix), not a second one: two seats found one edit, and the fix round should treat it as one.
sharpenedFix: This finding's normaliser is the better of the two proposed (it strips \u2026 and collapses whitespace); use it and drop the duplicate. The single edit also clears the accessible repeat, since task.note sits in the sr describedby list at src/tasks.js:452 behind filter(Boolean). Guard the assertion in interaction-check.mjs on the normalised comparison, not on the literal sentence, so a re-worded fixture cannot quietly re-open it.
